'''Masax''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He resided on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], working as a merchant at the [[Promenade]].<ref name="TOR" />
